title: Mixing Matters: Evidence Position Bias Across Sequence Mixers in Long-Context Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.31135v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context models often use answer-bearing evidence less effectively when it appears away from a prompt boundary. We compare this position bias across Transformer, state-space, and hybrid Mamba architectures by moving one gold document through a fixed set of nine distractors. The evaluated Transformers show a beginning advantage that the evaluated state-space models lack, while both families favor evidence near the end. A matched pure-versus-hybrid Mamba comparison points in the same direction but remains statistically uncertain. The family difference appears among models that can answer the task. Transformer primacy reappears on synthetic retrieval, where state-space ceiling prevents a family comparison. A corpus swap within one state-space architecture changes overall accuracy without a detectable change in curve shape. Prompt changes can create or nearly remove a beginning advantage. Position remains decodable across architectures e

translated_title: 混合很重要：长上下文问答中不同序列混合架构的证据位置偏差研究
translated_abstract: 长上下文模型在包含答案的证据出现在远离提示边界的位置时，往往无法有效利用这些证据。我们通过将一份黄金文档在固定的九个干扰文档集合中移动位置，比较了Transformer、状态空间以及混合Mamba架构之间的这种位置偏差。被评估的Transformer模型显示出开头优势，而被评估的状态空间模型缺乏这种优势，同时两个家族的模型都更偏好接近末尾的证据。一项匹配的纯Mamba与混合Mamba对比指向相同的方向，但在统计上仍不确定。这种家族差异体现在能够完成该任务的模型之中。Transformer的首要地位在合成检索任务中再次显现，而状态空间模型的性能天花板使得家族间的比较无法进行。在同一状态空间架构内更换语料库会改变总体准确率，但曲线形状没有可检测到的变化。提示的改变可以产生或几乎消除开头优势。位置信息在各架构中仍然是可解码的。
tldr: 本研究通过在干扰文档中移动黄金证据，系统比较了Transformer、状态空间和混合Mamba架构在长上下文问答中的证据位置偏差，发现Transformer模型具有状态空间模型所缺乏的开头优势，而两类架构均偏好接近末尾的证据。
en_tdlr: By moving a gold document among distractors, this study systematically compares evidence position bias across Transformer, state-space, and hybrid Mamba architectures in long-context question answering, finding that Transformers exhibit a beginning advantage that state-space models lack, while both families favor evidence near the end.
